item.title: Daily Podcast 2026-08-17
item.description: Today’s papers collectively shift how we think about moving from design to manufacturable biologics, about screening emergent functions in cell‑free systems, about imaging‑based quality control, about AI‑assisted surgical planning, and about the hidden dynamics of drug targets. | Thinking about the hydroxyapatite chromatography work on disassembled capsid proteins, I wonder if we could push that purification principle further by coupling it directly to in‑line assembly of virus‑like particles. | Moving to the PUREdrop microfluidic platform, its ability to compartmentalize cell‑free expression in ~20 µl droplets made me think about screening for proteins that need a lipid environment to function, like membrane‑associated enzymes.
